name: How long does it take to install new bathroom floor tile?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new bathroom floor tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most bathroom floor tile installations take 2 to 4 days to complete. The process involves removing old flooring, inspecting the subfloor, laying an uncoupling membrane or backer board, setting the tile with mortar, and applying grout and sealant. Drying times are essential to long-term durability. Mortar typically needs 24 hours to cure before grouting can begin, and grout requires another 24 hours before you can walk on the floor or re-install bathroom fixtures like the toilet and vanity. Larger master bathrooms or intricate mosaic layouts may take an extra day or two.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom floor tile installation typically takes 2 to 4 days, accounting for subfloor prep, thin-set curing, and grout drying before the floor can be walked on.
